{{Quote|Orbital Security Station Six to Coruscant Control. Checking in. Nothing to see here but stars&hellip;|Femi|<ref name="threatpeace">''[[The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 1: Treaty of Coruscant]]''</ref>}}
'''Coruscant Control''' was a [[Realspace/Legends|space]] traffic central control for the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]]. It was in charge of monitoring the space traffic coming and leaving the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] eras.<ref name="SWTORcorus" /> [[Orbital security station/Legends|Orbital security stations]] would call Control to report in.<ref name="threatpeace" /> In [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}} places the events of ''[[The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 1: Treaty of Coruscant]]'' in the same [[Standard year/Legends|year]] as the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], which appeared in ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''. Since ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''Deceived'' to [[3653 BBY]], ''Treaty of Coruscant'' must also take place in that year.</ref> an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of CSF, [[Femi]], reported to Coruscant Control from [[Orbital Security Station Six]] that all was clear. Moments later, the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] entered Coruscant space and began their [[Sacking of Coruscant|invasion]].<ref name="threatpeace" /> As the Cold War continued, Coruscant Control was in charge of clearing [[Starship/Legends|starships]] leaving the [[Coruscant Spaceport]].<ref name="SWTORcorus" />

==Behind the scenes==
Coruscant Control first appeared in the first issue of the opening [[The Old Republic, Threat of Peace Act 1: Treaty of Coruscant|arc]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic, Threat of Peace]]'', which was written by [[Robert Chestney]]<ref name="threatpeace" /> and began publication on [[February 27]], [[2009]].<ref name="RSS">{{TORweb|url=feed/media/webcomic|text=RSS Feed for ''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Webcomics &mdash; June 22, 2009}}</ref> The [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] served as a prequel to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'',<ref name="threatpeace" /> a [[Star Wars video games|Massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] made by [[BioWare]].<ref name="SWTORcorus" />
